source_anchor: Only conjugation covariance and signed full-Haar rotation invariance of the literal centered Gaussian formula sqrt(det A)/(2pi)^(n/2) exp(-x^T A x/2). This is the for-every-fixed-Q invariance step underlying Ex58, not the additional orthogonal transitivity/axis identification x -> ||x||e1. The formula is explicit in local lets: no Gaussian probability law or density characterization is chosen or claimed, and no assumed density/normalizer is a caller premise.

proposed_signatures.signed_kernel_rotation_invariant:
theorem signed_kernel_rotation_invariant {n : ℕ} (_hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ}
    (_hκ : 4 ≤ κ) :
    let p : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ :=
      fun O x => Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det /
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
          Real.exp (-(x ⬝ᵥ (singleBlockPrecision κ O *ᵥ x)) / 2)
    (∀ x : Fin n → ℝ, Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * p O x) (orthogonalHaar n)) ∧
    ∀ (Q : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) (x : Fin n → ℝ),
      (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det *
          p O ((Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) *ᵥ x) ∂orthogonalHaar n) =
      (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * p O x ∂orthogonalHaar n)

meaning_definitions.orthogonalHaar: Existing actual normalized Haar probability on full real O(n), including reflections, with canonical Borel structure.
meaning_definitions.p: Literal displayed real Gaussian formula with source precision. No measure is defined by it; normalization, covariance, and identification with N(0,A^-1) remain excluded.
meaning_definitions.vectors: Finite real coordinate vectors on Fin n; dotProduct is the Euclidean quadratic form; Q acts by ordinary matrix mulVec. Real exponent (n:R)/2 is not natural-number division.
